newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Easing yen in focus on Hungary's FX futures market.
newsitem.headline: Easing yen in focus on Hungary's FX futures market.

text.p: Falling yen futures were in the focus of foreign exchange futures trading on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) on Tuesday, while the mark and the dollar finished mixed.
Yen futures which fell for all of the four maturities traded on Tuesday, represented 15,030 lots of the total turnover of 27,978 lots.
"The yen eased in the crosses," said Gabor Herczeg of LaSalle Rt. "It has weakened in the forint cross, and futures quotes on the bourse followed that."

June yen closed at 147.45 forints for 100 units, down 0.55, September yen eased 60 fillers to 154.60, while the December maturity finished at 161.60, down 40 pips. The settlement price for March 1998 yen futures was 166.95, down five fillers.
Dollar and mark futures finished mixed following recent hectic movements in the dollar/mark spot rates, dealers said.
Dollar futures closed lower for March 1998 and firmer for June, September and December. Mark futures dropped 10 pips to 112.50 forints for September, and remained untraded for other maturities.
Demand for dollar futures was strong on the BCE and they were bought at the levels of the offers of commercial banks, dealers said. Dollar futures were traded in 4,343 lots.
"The market appears to expect the dollar to rise," said Herczeg.
Total turnover of foreign currency futures on the BCE rose to 4.33 billion forints, from 4.17 billion forints on Monday.
The dollar remained steady for all maturities on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE), except for December, for which it dropped one forint and finished at 196 forints.
The mark closed mixed on the BSE, although most maturities remained steady. The most active May traded in 270 lots, and closed at 106.74 forints, up 14 fillers.

The yen was fixed by the National Bank of Hungary at 142.48 forints for 100 units on Tuesday, down from 143.28 on Monday. The dollar fixing rose to 180.05 forints from 179.65, while the mark eased to 105.38 forints from 105.48.
